prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the German language

learning_outcomes.text: Reach their fellow students via at least one communication channel (phone, messenger, e-mail)
Contact the program director, academic advisor, and dean's office via email
Create and execute small programs and audio clips in the Scratch programming environment
Independently reinstall the VirtualBox virtualization system on their own computers if needed
Start the virtual machine installed on their computers as part of the introductory project, create configuration files, and create, compile, and execute program files with a text editor

syllabus_topics: Formation of teams/small groups, social networking
Getting to know important contact points and people on campus
Introduction to the Scratch programming environment
Creation of a profile for all team members in the form of a Scratch application
Installation of the VirtualBox virtualization system and a virtual machine that will be used in lectures of the first and second semesters
Introduction to the basic operation of the virtual machine
Creating and executing simple program files
assessment_rules: For the introductory project, attendance is mandatory on all three days. Additionally, participants must attend the library introduction event and pass the associated online test.
